project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4
build_command: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run npx tsc --noEmit (ignore prisma-client errors), npm run lint, npm run build
environment_constraints: Full internet access. content/metadata/imported-questions/ directory does not exist in sandbox (was on user's local machine). API route must handle missing directory gracefully. Pre-existing TypeScript errors in prisma/seed.ts and src/shared/lib/prisma/client.ts (cannot find prisma client module) - these are expected and should be ignored.
contribution_requirements: Never use useSyncExternalStore. Never call router.push() during render. typeof window !== 'undefined' guard before localStorage. Lazy-load Recharts with dynamic import { ssr: false }. No hardcoded hex colors except in var() fallbacks. Mobile-first. Commit after each bunch.
key_patterns: Feature-based folders in src/features/{name}/. Components are 'use client' with useState(() => ...) for localStorage reads. Session storage uses cfa-buddy-sessions localStorage key. Questions loaded via loadAllQuestions() from question-loader.ts which combines sampleQuestions + localStorage imported questions. CSS variables for theming (--accent-primary, --card-bg, --foreground, etc). lucide-react for icons.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ has all app routes. src/features/question-bank/ is the main feature module with components/, utils/, types/, data/, hooks/ (empty). src/app/api/ has content/, scanner/, search/ routes. content/metadata/ exists but imported-questions/ subfolder does not exist in sandbox.
